claims: "Golden" from the film KPop Demon Hunters won Best Original Song at the 98th Academy Awards on March 15, 2026.
"Golden" is the first K-pop song to win an Oscar.
"Golden" had an 18-week run atop the Billboard Hot 100.
Music and lyrics for "Golden" from KPop Demon Hunters are by EJAE, Mark Sonnenblick, Joong Gyu Kwak, Yu Han Lee, Hee Dong Nam, Jeong Hoon Seo, and Teddy Park.
"Golden" was performed live by EJAE, Audrey Nuna, and Rei Ami during the 98th Academy Awards ceremony.
EJAE, Audrey Nuna, and Rei Ami are the singing voices behind the film's fictional group HUNTR/X.
HUNTR/X is performed by EJAE, Audrey Nuna, and Rei Ami.
"Dear Me" from Diane Warren: Relentless by Diane Warren was a nominee for Best Original Song at the 98th Academy Awards.
"I Lied To You" from Sinners by Raphael Saadiq and Ludwig Goransson was a nominee for Best Original Song at the 98th Academy Awards.
"Sweet Dreams Of Joy" from Viva Verdi! by Nicholas Pike was a nominee for Best Original Song at the 98th Academy Awards.
"Train Dreams" from Train Dreams by Nick Cave and Bryce Dessner was a nominee for Best Original Song at the 98th Academy Awards.
